metadata.description: AI coding skill for gohud, the HUD & UI kit for Godot 4.7+ (tested on Godot 4.7; officially supports Godot 4.7 and newer). Build menus, HUDs, dialogs, sheets, forms, app screens and themes with gohud, preview its demo scenes, and list its features. Install it with /plugin install gohud --marketplace thruthesky/gohud.

plugins.name: gohud
plugins.description: Build Godot 4.7+ game and app UI with gohud (tested on Godot 4.7; officially supports Godot 4.7 and newer): menus, HUDs placed by corner anchors or edge bars, quick slots, joystick, summon columns, dialogs, sheets, drawers, forms, snackbars, app screens with Flutter's widgets, fourteen presets (default, sci-fi, medieval, Material 3 Expressive, kids, comic, arcade), JSON themes, skins and icon sets. Includes /gohud:preview to launch the gallery or demo and /gohud:features to explain every feature. Install: /plugin install gohud --marketplace thruthesky/gohud (Claude Code 2.1.275+); on older versions, /plugin marketplace add thruthesky/gohud first, then /plugin install gohud@gohud.
